projects.description: Multi-tenant B2B CRM — four roles with real RBAC, drag-and-drop pipeline, invoicing with payment reconciliation, and six AI tools that degrade to working heuristics with no API key.
Airbnb clone with overlap-safe reservations, Stripe checkout (test mode + mock fallback), Leaflet maps, and a host earnings dashboard.
Home page rebuilt from a measured audit of the live original — fixed a WCAG contrast failure, cut a 53-link mega-menu to five, replaced 79 images with pure CSS.
Music streaming app built around an audio singleton that keeps playback outside React's render cycle — no stuttering on re-render, no leaked audio elements.
